Drag or use the arrows
1
Carthage

Hannibal’s impossible road

Order dated records, crack a cipher and rebuild a curator’s display.

2
Bardo

The mosaic’s missing witness

Sixteen tiles, repeating edges. Only the whole picture is true.

3
Medina of Tunis

The souk after closing

Match chechias, silk and silver, then read letters through a frame.

4
Sidi Bou Said

The palace that kept a song

Turn a dial with each instrument. A missed rehearsal changes everything.

5
La Goulette

The port of many tables

Sixteen true statements and one harbour manifest to restore.

6
Modern Tunis

Before the curtain rises

Build a symbolic city and repair six damaged stage routes.

7
The Tunis Cabinet

The atlas of seven lives

Repair the switches and pass both audits to open the archive.

A box you play, then keep

  • 7 challenges with hints, printed in the box
  • A host guide to run the session
  • Made for 3 to 4 players per team
  • Offline: no phone, internet or speaker
  • Great as a hosted session for hotels, guesthouses and guides

Born in Hack the Wild

24 SECRETS grew inside the Hack the Wild membership program, funded by the U.S. Embassy Tunis. It gave us a community of builders to play-test with and the push to turn an idea into a box.
